@lewis_george_gfc1 trained by Luke Phillips from @gfcmuaythai in Manchester. Makes his return to Masda Fight Night in fantastic form. After an impressive victory over the European Champion on one of the world's biggest events at @yokkao - Lewis has now been given a dream shot at the vacant International title right here in Liverpool on @mtgpfightnight 

@maxielrayo trained by the top team at @boonchuay13
Gym in Barcelona is no stranger to the bright lights or the big stage. The WBC Spanish and Catalonian champion ranked 12 in the world is coming to spoil the party. He said he is very excited for his debut on @mtgpfightnight in Liverpool

This will be a main card classic to remember with both fighters having their eyes on world titles in 2027.

Who wins❓️you decide.
